final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rfistat AS r, AVG(modindex) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS b FROM signals), s3 AS (SELECT s1.r AS r, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS c FROM s3) SELECT s3.r, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a - s4.c AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.c IS NOT NULL
